bill.title: Home-Based Business Fairness Act.

posted_text:
🏗️ NC HB 372 — You Can Run Your Business From Home – Now With More Rules

North Carolina is letting cities regulate home-based businesses, but only if they’re ‘no-impact’ – meaning they don’t add traffic, sell restricted goods, or violate neighborhood rules.

July 7, 2026: Signed by Gov.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/HB372
